It serves as the home for SDSU football and professional soccer tenants (including San Diego Wave FC and San Diego FC), and hosts concerts and large community events. The venue enforces a clear-bag policy (permitted clear bag sizes and one small non-clear clutch rules are posted), offers bag-check lockers for purchase on the east side, provides mobile ticketing support, and promotes sustainability initiatives.
